name: X Addons for Elementor
author: pencilwp

sections.description:
X Addons Elementor is an exceptional plugin designed to elevate your elementor website to the next level. We’ve crafted a collection of stunning and innovative elementor addons to enhance your website’s functionality and aesthetics. Whether you want to build eye-catching hero sections, showcase your services, display testimonials, or create interactive sliders, X Addons Elementor gives you the tools you need. Every widget is lightweight, responsive, and easy to use, making it perfect for beginners and professionals alike.

Features

  • Unique and stylish Elementor addons to enhance your website’s design and functionality.
  • Simple and intuitive customization options to personalize your website according to your preferences.
  • Seamless integration with the Elementor page builder for a smooth user experience.

⚡ Widgets in Free Version

  • Hero Area – Create stunning hero sections with headlines and buttons.
  • Service Card – Showcase your services with modern service cards.
  • Testimonial Slider – Display client feedback in a beautiful slider.
  • Portfolio Slider – Highlight portfolio projects in a stylish slider.
  • Tabs Widget – Organize content into elegant responsive tabs.
  • Blog Widgets – Show recent posts or blog grids with custom layouts.
  • Brand, Client or Partners Slider – Showcase logos in a smooth slider.
  • Circle Progress Card – Display progress or stats with animated circles.
  • Call to Action Card – Grab attention with attractive CTA cards.
  • Stylish Image Card – Present images with creative hover effects.
  • Contact Info Card – Share business contact details in a neat card.
  • Image Card – Simple and elegant image display with text support.
  • Progress List – Show milestones or steps with progress indicators.
  • Section Title – Add beautifully designed section headings.
  • Buttons Widget – Create stylish customizable buttons.
  • List Style Types – Display lists with modern icons and styles.
  • Navigation Menu Widget – Add custom navigation menus with styling.
  • Contact Form 7 Integrated – Embed and style Contact Form 7 forms.
  • Mailchimp Form Integrated – Collect subscribers with Mailchimp forms.
    • More coming.

Credits

This plugin was created by Pencilwp.

Support

For support and inquiries, please contact support@pencilwp.com.

Resource Credits

All third-party resources and assets used in this plugin are GPL v2 or later, or MIT licensed, ensuring compatibility with open-source software standards.

License

This plugin is released under the GPL v2 or later License. See the LICENSE file for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the x-addons-elementor file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will now see new widgets and features added to your Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
How do I use the new addons added by this plugin?

Once the plugin is activated, simply open the Elementor editor, and you’ll find the new addons available in the Elementor widgets panel. Example search (XA: Service Card)
